question: Does any available reproducible scorer reach the frozen >=80% M0 target-presence adequacy gate on the artistic-style panel?
answer: No. Three bounded attempts, all below the gate. Effectiveness measurement is BLOCKED.

attempts_in_order.rule: CLIP ViT-L/14 argmax over 10 artists + 'a plain photograph with no particular artistic style'; template 'an artwork in the style of {label}'
attempts_in_order.when: frozen before any image was generated

attempts_in_order.rule: frozen rule, images regenerated at FLUX native 1024x1024 instead of the author's 512x512
attempts_in_order.status: failed; resolution is not the cause

attempts_in_order.rule: null label REMOVED, argmax over the 10 artist labels only, same template

agent_visual_check.what: AGENT judgement (not human review) on the fixed-order M0 contact sheet evidence/contact_sheets/M0_Vincent_van_Gogh_canonical.jpg, all 40 canonical cases in frozen case order
agent_visual_check.finding: The panel is unmistakable Van Gogh pastiche -- Starry-Night swirled skies, sunflowers in a yellow vase, wheat fields, the cafe terrace at night, worn boots, cypresses, irises, impasto brushwork and the yellow/blue palette. The agent judges the great majority of the 40 to carry the target style.
agent_visual_check.implication: The GENERATOR is not the failing component. The SCORER is. CLIP ViT-L/14 zero-shot artist-identity discrimination is not a sufficiently sensitive instrument for this task, which is why the style-erasure literature (e.g. UnlearnCanvas) uses a TRAINED style classifier instead.
agent_visual_check.correction: An earlier working note in this pilot attributed the low rates to FLUX not rendering the style at 512px. That attribution is WRONG and is withdrawn; the 1024px probe and this visual check both contradict it.

stopping_rule_applied: Two scorer recalibrations plus one resolution probe were tried and all are reported. No further variants were searched: continuing until an instrument passes would be selecting the measurement by its outcome, which the brief forbids.
